blocks.explanation:
Bracket mein \(\sin x\) aur \(\cos 3x\) hain, angles alag alag hain, is liye inhein jor nahi sakte. Integral ko do hisson mein torenge: \(A - 3B\).
\(A = \int e^{3x}\sin x\,dx\) bilkul Example 35 hai, \(a = 3\) aur \(b = 1\) ke saath; beech wali shakal \(\frac{e^{ax}}{a^2 + b^2}(a\sin bx - b\cos bx)\) use karenge.
\(B = \int e^{3x}\cos 3x\,dx\) ko do dafa parts se nikalenge; \(B\) wapas aayega aur equation solve karenge.
Plan: \(A\), phir \(B\), phir \(A - 3B\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int e^{3x}(\sin x - 3\cos 3x)\,dx = A - 3B\).
Maloom karna: \(A\), \(B\) aur poora integral.
Tareeqa: \(A\) Example 35 se (\(a = 3\), \(b = 1\)); \(B\) do dafa parts se (dono dafa trigonometric first), phir \(B\) solve.

\(A\) (Example 35 se)
\[A = \int e^{3x}\sin x\,dx = \dfrac{e^{3x}}{3^2 + 1^2}(3\sin x - \cos x)\]
\[= \dfrac{e^{3x}}{10}(3\sin x - \cos x)\]
Kyun: Example 35 mein saabit kiya tha: \(\int e^{ax}\sin bx\,dx = \frac{e^{ax}}{a^2+b^2}(a\sin bx - b\cos bx)\). \(a = 3\), \(b = 1\) rakhe.

\(B\) par pehli dafa parts
\[B = \cos 3x\cdot\dfrac{e^{3x}}{3} - \int \dfrac{e^{3x}}{3}(-3\sin 3x)\,dx\]
\[= \dfrac{e^{3x}\cos 3x}{3} + \int e^{3x}\sin 3x\,dx\]
Kyun: \(\cos 3x\) first (derivative \(-3\sin 3x\)), \(e^{3x}\) second (integral \(\frac{e^{3x}}{3}\)); 3 cancel aur minus plus ban gaya.

Doosri dafa parts
\[\int e^{3x}\sin 3x\,dx = \sin 3x\cdot\dfrac{e^{3x}}{3} - \int \dfrac{e^{3x}}{3}(3\cos 3x)\,dx\]
\[= \dfrac{e^{3x}\sin 3x}{3} - B\]
Kyun: wohi choice, \(\sin 3x\) first; aakhri integral bilkul \(B\) hai.
Dhyan dein: doosri dafa \(e^{3x}\) ko first mat banaiye, warna pehle round ka kaam ulat jayega.

\(B\) solve karein
\[B = \dfrac{e^{3x}\cos 3x}{3} + \dfrac{e^{3x}\sin 3x}{3} - B\]
\[2B = \dfrac{e^{3x}}{3}(\cos 3x + \sin 3x)\]
\[B = \dfrac{e^{3x}}{6}(\cos 3x + \sin 3x)\]
Kyun: \(-B\) ko left par laye, \(2B\) bana, phir 2 se divide.

\(A - 3B\)
\[= \dfrac{e^{3x}}{10}(3\sin x - \cos x)\]
\[\quad - \dfrac{e^{3x}}{2}(\cos 3x + \sin 3x) + c\]
Kyun: \(3B = \frac{3}{6}e^{3x}(\ldots) = \frac{e^{3x}}{2}(\ldots)\); aakhir mein ek constant \(c\).

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left[\dfrac{e^{3x}}{10}(3\sin x - \cos x)\right] = e^{3x}\sin x\]
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left[\dfrac{e^{3x}}{2}(\cos 3x + \sin 3x)\right] = 3e^{3x}\cos 3x\]
Kyun: pehle ka derivative \(e^{3x}\cdot\frac{10\sin x}{10}\) aur doosre ka \(\frac{e^{3x}}{2}\cdot 6\cos 3x\); minus karne se integrand mila.
